title: Aromatic Charred Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian dish featuring charred lamb in a rich and aromatic sauce, served with crusty bread or over rice.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic granules, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, and prunes to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2.5 hours, or until it is tender and the sauce has thickened.
